title: Make the deep metadata release-probe witness exercise its claimed layout
outcome: The release-probe regression clearly distinguishes a layout arithmetic witness from execution with a deep metadata directory.
acceptance: Either drive the release probe with the representative deep metadata directory and discriminate a depth-dependent regression, or name/document it explicitly as an arithmetic layout witness with an appropriate independent behavior control.
Preserve existing successful handle-release, startup-error, short-scratch and short Windows checkout controls without increasing timeouts.
